description: This Java class 'PersonMergeLogData' serves as a data transfer object for logging and serializing the details of a patient's merge operation in the OpenMRS healthcare system. It contains various fields to track UUIDs of merged entities (visits, encounters, programs, relationships, observations, orders, identifiers, addresses, names, attributes, users) and the previous state of demographic data such as gender and dates of birth/death. The class provides getter, setter, and adder methods, along with a hash computation method for change tracking.

classes.name: PersonMergeLogData
classes.description: A data container for serializing and logging merge details of patient records during a merge operation.
